title: Spicy Korean Noodle Curry
description: A fusion of Indian and Korean flavors in this spicy noodle curry.

ingredients.name: Exotic spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and cinnamon

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add onion, garlic, and ginger. Cook until onion is translucent.
Add chili flakes and exotic spices. Cook for 1 minute.
Add Mongolian myeongnan and cook for 2 minutes.
Add noodles and cook until heated through.
Add 2 cups of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Season with salt and serve hot.
Garnish with toasted sesame seeds and chopped scallions (optional)
